run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the nth number whose sum of digits equals ten
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input parameters to verify correct nth digit-sum results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which iterates from 19 incrementing by 9 to find numbers with digit sum 10
